zh.what: 广场安装的技能和工作流可以卸载到可找回的备份；卸载后仍保留发布者信任和版本记录，重新安装继续接受原有校验。
zh.action: 让 Agent 运行 agentj plaza uninstall <名称>，在已有确认卡上核对后批准；自行改过的目录不会被直接移走。

en.what: Uninstall Plaza skills and workflows into a recoverable backup. Publisher trust and version history remain in place for checks on reinstall.
en.action: Ask your Agent to run agentj plaza uninstall <name>, review the existing confirmation card and approve it. Edited directories are refused.

zh.what: 安装说明明确了普通容器与完整云服务器的支持边界，并将隔离预检放在绑定账号和席位之前；socat 依赖只适用于 Claude。
zh.action: 在容器里安装时，先运行 agentj doctor --isolation-only --json；手动运行仍需自行安排重启和恢复。

en.what: Installation guidance distinguishes ordinary containers from fully managed cloud servers, places isolation checks before account and seat binding, and marks socat as Claude-only.
en.action: For a container installation, first run agentj doctor --isolation-only --json. Manual operation still needs your own restart and recovery arrangements.

zh.what: 客服回复未通过自动审核时，现在明确提示已转人工，不再把这类情况说成出站网络失败。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: When a support reply fails automatic review, the message now explains that it was referred for human review instead of suggesting an outbound network failure.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: ElevenLabs 朗读支持主人本机自选文本前缀、稳定性和相似度参数；默认不加前缀，也不改变原有朗读设置。
zh.action: 需要自定义时，让 Agent 配置 voice.tts.text_prefix 与 voice.tts.settings 的 elevenlabs 项；不设置则保持原样。

en.what: ElevenLabs speech supports an optional local text prefix, stability and similarity settings. Defaults keep the existing speech behavior without adding a prefix.
en.action: To customize speech, ask your Agent to configure the elevenlabs entries in voice.tts.text_prefix and voice.tts.settings. Leave them unset to keep the current behavior.

zh.what: 同主人主机发来的主动报告遇到本机秘密扫描来源变化时，会重新扫描一次再接收；仍无法完成检查时会明确拒绝。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Proactive reports from your other hosts retry the local secret scan once when its sources change. A scan that remains incomplete still refuses delivery.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: Claude 原生后台 Bash 任务结束时，完成通知会沿用真实的结束状态，不再因缺少退出码而误说没有收到完成事件。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Completion notices for native Claude background Bash tasks now use the actual terminal status instead of claiming that no completion event arrived when an exit code is absent.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: 修复好友消息在本机扫描资料有大量重复值时误报主机未运行的问题；扫描不完整会给出准确原因，原有秘密拦截仍然保留。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Fixes friend messages incorrectly reporting that the host is not running when local scan sources contain many duplicate values. Incomplete scans report the proper cause and retain secret filtering.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: 你主动发送的消息排队时，沿用现有排队卡；按钮改为“停止当前任务”。经校验的本人微信、Telegram 和邮件消息在 Web App 中采用同一策略。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。原渠道继续接收最终回复，不额外发送新的排队回执。

en.what: Messages you send retain the existing queue card, with its button renamed to “Stop current task”. Verified messages from your WeChat, Telegram and email use the same policy in the Web App.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed. Original channels still receive final replies, without a new outbound queue receipt.

zh.what: 后台任务、Webhook、心跳和定时任务等自动消息安静排队，处理前不再占用前端排队卡；有实际回复后照常显示。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Automatic messages such as background tasks, webhooks, heartbeats and scheduled jobs queue quietly without a pending card. Actual replies appear normally.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: 消息已被当前会话接收处理后，即使没有可见回复，也不会误弹“尚未接收”或排队提示；真正未送达的消息仍保留失败提示。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Once the current session has consumed a message, a silent reply no longer causes a false unreceived or queue notice. Genuine delivery failures still keep their failure notice.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: 修复回复另起一张卡的问题，让回复留在原消息卡上；静默处理的消息不再留下空白回复卡。
zh.action: 升级后自动生效，无需另设。

en.what: Fixes replies appearing on a separate card, keeping them with the original message. Silently handled messages no longer leave an empty reply card.
en.action: Takes effect after upgrading; no extra setup is needed.

zh.what: 修复自然语言压缩请求已排队却被拒绝的问题；Agent 可写好交接后自行压缩，再读取交接继续工作。
zh.action: 告诉 Agent“先写交接，再压缩并按交接继续”，无需手动输入压缩命令。

en.what: Fixes queued context-compaction requests being refused. Your Agent can write a handoff, compact the conversation, then read the handoff and resume work.
en.action: Ask your Agent to write a handoff, compact the conversation and continue from the handoff; no manual compact command is needed.

zh.what: 改进弹出卡片：按钮使用清晰的实底配色，标题周围留白更充足，收起操作统一为圆形箭头图标。
zh.action: 升级并重新打开网页后即可使用。

en.what: Improves popup cards with solid-color buttons, more space around titles and consistent circular arrow icons for collapsing cards.
en.action: Upgrade and reopen the webpage to use the updated cards.
